s.how: Brush 6 nori sheets lightly with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds and a pinch of salt. Toast one at a time in a dry pan for 30 seconds a side until crisp. Cut into strips with scissors and pile into a bowl like a kelp forest.

Arrange 2 cups watermelon cubes, 1 punnet hulled strawberries, 2 sliced kiwi fruit, 1 punnet blueberries and 500g green grapes in colour blocks on a big platter so the fruit 'hides' in patches. Serve with 200g vanilla yoghurt in a bowl for dipping.

m.note: the Marine Life Institute in California
m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lime juice, chilli and salt, then grill and slice. Build bowls of long grain rice with the chicken, sliced avocado, corn, black beans and a spoon of salsa. A California beach lunch in a bowl.

w.how: Make up 2 packets of blue jelly and pour into glasses. Chill for 3 hours until set. Top with whipped cream and tuck a slice of orange on top of each for a little orange fish. Just keep eating.

d.note: the open ocean where Dory finds her parents
d.how: Pour cold lemonade into tall glasses and add a drop of blue colouring, stirring until ocean blue. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and foams. Serve straight away with a long spoon.
